mechanism: Perphenazine has anticholinergic and alpha-adrenergic blocking properties that potentiate the hypotensive effects of hydrochlorothiazide, and hydrochlorothiazide-induced hypokalemia increases risk of perphenazine-related cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, assess for orthostatic hypotension, and monitor serum potassium levels; consider potassium supplementation if needed.
